approval_phrase: I authorize one development-only X-COP run of the frozen extended-source clock law on A1644, A1795, A2142, A2255, A2319, A3266, A85, and ZW1215 only, using the existing local density, pressure, temperature, and five available stellar-profile files; open no confirmation, independent, group, or lensing data; make no network, model, paid, or tuning calls; do not retune a0, the factor 2, or the transition rule; retain every failure and counterexample.
